dict.string: AudioSync shows the current track and its play/pause/skip controls for Spotify and Music, and sends the track to AirPlay speakers with a screen, such as a TV.
AudioSync captures the audio you choose (all system audio or one app) to play it in sync on your local and AirPlay speakers.
AudioSync finds and streams to the AirPlay speakers (HomePod, Apple TV, AirPlay receivers) and Google Cast speakers on your network.

AudioSync reads the input device you choose (microphone, line-in or audio interface) to play it on your speakers, and the microphone when you calibrate a speaker's delay. Calibration recordings stay in memory and are never saved or sent.
